description: Owned active fork of the real-time Jeopardy-style game with shared engine, host/display/player views and server contracts.
runtime: TypeScript / Next.js / Vitest / Prisma client generation

setup.purpose: Install committed package-lock dependencies without arbitrary install hooks or browser/runtime downloads.
Existing build first step: generate local client types only; no DB migration, connection or seed.

integrity.purpose: JSON integrity only; trusted schema validation is separate.
Existing package typecheck command; source/type integrity.

targeted.purpose: Existing game state, scoring, board import, answer matching and fuzz/property fixtures.

integration.purpose: Existing server/auth/socket/storage-boundary and pure draft-format fixtures; no provider draft call or DB service.

delivery.build: npm run build generates Prisma client, Next.js artifacts and the custom server. This source acceptance lane does not run a production build or DB deployment.
delivery.run: npm start serves dist/server.js; npm run dev uses tsx. Docker/Fly/self-hosted deployment paths remain owned by the project; none is invoked.
delivery.observe: Actual synchronized host/display/player flows, room/auth boundaries and database migrations require the running owned deployment. Source fixtures do not prove public/upstream instance health.
delivery.recovery: Preserve database/user board/game state and prior deploy image. Restore the previous owned release through its deployment path and use compatible schema recovery; never point tests at a real database or send mail/model requests.

consumers: Owned Trivia Pig host/display/player browser clients
external_dependencies: PostgreSQL and optional storage/OIDC/mail/Anthropic providers for production only
coverage_notes: Protected paths contain independent check definitions/fixtures only; product implementation, source data, manifests and runtime configuration remain candidate-visible.
Empty stages denote absent coverage. No live observation/deployment or provider/model call is performed by this contract.
Fork status does not exclude this owned active project. The descriptor applies to andredubbs/trivia-pig, not the upstream maintainer or public instance.

Vitest uses the Node environment and existing pure/mock server boundaries. No database migration/seed, model draft, mail, provider call, browser or production deploy runs. Full Next/server build and rendered multiplayer UI remain absent coverage.
